title: Jira ticket evidence
description: One Jira ticket cited as evidence (e.g., a change ticket). 1.1.0 (#2829) adds assignee_account_id, labels, priority, severity, created_at and resolved_at; a field the connector has no value for is omitted.

assignee_account_id.description: The assignee's Jira accountId. Stable where the display name is not.

labels.description: The issue's labels, verbatim. Omitted when it has none.

priority.description: The name of the issue's priority, verbatim.

severity.description: The connector's --severity-field (default priority) normalised: critical, high, medium or low, case-insensitively, and priority Highest and Lowest as critical and low. Omitted when the value is absent or not one of those.

created_at.description: When the issue was created (Jira field created), RFC 3339 in UTC.

resolved_at.description: When the issue was resolved (Jira field resolutiondate), RFC 3339 in UTC. Omitted while it is unresolved.
